rooms.name: Messy Bedroom
rooms.description: You wake up in a modern but messy bedroom. You hear a faint ringing sound coming from somewhere in the apartment. The living room is to the east.

rooms.name: Luxury Penthouse
rooms.description: A huge living room with a breathtaking city view. The kitchen is to the south, and your bedroom is west. The balcony door to the north is magically sealed.

npcs.name: spirit
npcs.description: A floating digital head of John Pork. He looks annoyed that you haven't answered his call.

dialogs.calling: Ringtone intensifies... *I just called to say...*
dialogs.happy: You finally answered! The vibe is now immaculate. The balcony door is open.

rooms.name: Modern Kitchen
rooms.description: A sleek kitchen with marble counters. The ringing sound is deafening here. The penthouse is back to the north.

items.name: phone
items.description: The screen glows brightly. It says: 'JOHN PORK IS CALLING...'

rooms.name: The Skyline Balcony
rooms.description: You step out onto the glass balcony. The view is legendary. You feel an urge to look up at the sky. The penthouse is south.

rooms.name: Meme Heaven
rooms.description: You ascend to the clouds. John Pork nods at you in approval. You have achieved peak Vibe and won the game!
